sentences.en: It is Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 现在是周六早上。

sentences.en: Leo gets up and has breakfast at home.
sentences.zh: Leo 起床后在家吃早餐。

sentences.en: There is a text message from Mia on his phone.
sentences.zh: 他的手机上有一条 Mia 发来的短信。

sentences.en: The message says: "Look at the board in our classroom."
sentences.zh: 短信写着：“看看我们教室的黑板。”

sentences.en: "That's strange," Leo thinks.
sentences.zh: “真奇怪，”Leo 想。

sentences.en: "What does it mean?"
sentences.zh: “这是什么意思？”

sentences.en: Leo meets Jay at the school gate.
sentences.zh: Leo 在学校门口遇见 Jay。

sentences.en: "Mia says we need to look at the board," Leo says.
sentences.zh: “Mia 说我们得去看看黑板，”Leo 说。

sentences.en: "OK, let's go to the classroom," Jay says.
sentences.zh: “好，我们去教室吧，”Jay 说。

sentences.en: They go together.
sentences.zh: 他们一起走了。

sentences.en: Mia is in the classroom.
sentences.zh: Mia 在教室里。

sentences.en: The friends look at the board.
sentences.zh: 三个朋友看着黑板。

sentences.en: There is a short message on the board. It says: "Meet at the school gate at ten. Join the Saturday Club."
sentences.zh: 黑板上有一条短留言，写着：“十点在学校门口见面。加入周六俱乐部。”

sentences.en: "This is interesting," Mia says.
sentences.zh: “这很有意思，”Mia 说。

sentences.en: "Who is this message from?" Jay asks.
sentences.zh: “这条留言是谁发的？”Jay 问。

sentences.en: "I want to find out who it is," Leo says.
sentences.zh: “我想弄清楚这是谁，”Leo 说。

sentences.en: At ten o'clock, they meet at the school gate.
sentences.zh: 十点，他们在学校门口见面。

sentences.en: They look for a teacher or a student, but they do not see anyone new.
sentences.zh: 他们在找老师或同学，但没有看到任何新来的人。

sentences.en: Then Mia looks at the gate.
sentences.zh: 后来 Mia 看了看大门。

sentences.en: There is a small notice on the gate. The notice says: "Look for a blue book in the library. The name of the book is Saturday Club."
sentences.zh: 门上有一张小告示，写着：“去图书馆找一本蓝色的书。书名是 Saturday Club。”

sentences.en: The friends go to the library.
sentences.zh: 朋友们去图书馆。

sentences.en: They look for the blue book.
sentences.zh: 他们寻找那本蓝书。

sentences.en: Leo finds it next to a window.
sentences.zh: Leo 在一扇窗户旁边找到了它。

sentences.en: Inside the book, there is a short letter. The letter says: "Welcome to the Saturday Club. Come back next Saturday. Then you can find out more."
sentences.zh: 书里有一封短信，写着：“欢迎来到周六俱乐部。下周六再来。那时你们就能知道更多。”

sentences.en: The friends sit together and read the letter again.
sentences.zh: 朋友们坐在一起，又读了一遍那封信。

sentences.en: "This is a strange and interesting day," Mia says.
sentences.zh: “今天真奇怪，也很有意思，”Mia 说。

sentences.en: "I want to join the club," Jay says.
sentences.zh: “我想加入这个俱乐部，”Jay 说。

sentences.en: "Me too," Leo says.
sentences.zh: “我也是，”Leo 说。

sentences.en: "Let's come back next Saturday. We can find out together."
sentences.zh: “我们下周六再来吧。我们可以一起弄清楚。”

sentences.en: On the next page of the book, there is one more message: "See you next Saturday. Then you can find out my name."
sentences.zh: 在书的下一页，还有一条留言：“下周六见。到时你们就能知道我的名字。”

sentences.en: It is the next Saturday morning.
sentences.zh: 这是下一个星期六的早晨。

sentences.en: Leo, Mia and Jay come back to the school library.
sentences.zh: Leo、Mia 和 Jay 再次来到学校图书馆。

sentences.en: The blue book is on the table next to the window.
sentences.zh: 那本蓝书放在窗边的桌子上。

sentences.en: They wait for the person with the strange messages.
sentences.zh: 他们等着那个留下奇怪留言的人。

sentences.en: "Are you ready to find out?" Mia asks.
sentences.zh: “准备好揭晓答案了吗？”Mia 问。

sentences.en: "Yes, but where is everyone?" Jay asks.
sentences.zh: “准备好了，可是人都在哪儿呢？”Jay 问。

sentences.en: "Hello!" says a boy at the door.
sentences.zh: “你们好！”门口的一个男孩说。

sentences.en: The friends turn around.
sentences.zh: 朋友们转过身。

sentences.en: "My name is Alex. I'm a student here, too."
sentences.zh: “我叫 Alex。我也是这里的学生。”

sentences.en: "Are the messages from you?" Leo asks.
sentences.zh: “那些留言是你留的吗？”Leo 问。

sentences.en: "Yes. Welcome to the Saturday Club!"
sentences.zh: “是的。欢迎来到周六俱乐部！”

sentences.en: "Come in and sit down," Mia says.
sentences.zh: “进来坐吧，”Mia 说。

sentences.en: Alex sits next to Jay.
sentences.zh: Alex 坐在 Jay 旁边。

sentences.en: "Why the blue book?" Jay asks.
sentences.zh: “为什么要用这本蓝书呢？”Jay 问。

sentences.en: "I love books, and I want to make new friends," Alex says.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢书，也想交新朋友，”Alex 说。

sentences.en: "The messages are a game."
sentences.zh: “那些留言是一个游戏。”

sentences.en: "What do we do in this club?" Leo asks.
sentences.zh: “我们在这个俱乐部里做什么呢？”Leo 问。

sentences.en: "I have an idea," Alex says.
sentences.zh: “我有个主意，”Alex 说。

sentences.en: "We can read, play games and help people at school."
sentences.zh: “我们可以读书、玩游戏，还可以帮助学校里的人。”

sentences.en: "Can we draw, too?" Mia asks.
sentences.zh: “我们也可以画画吗？”Mia 问。

sentences.en: "Of course!" Alex says.
sentences.zh: “当然可以！”Alex 说。

sentences.en: Mia opens the blue book to a new page.
sentences.zh: Mia 翻开蓝书，翻到新的一页。

sentences.en: She writes four names: Leo, Mia, Jay and Alex.
sentences.zh: 她写下四个名字：Leo、Mia、Jay 和 Alex。

sentences.en: "Now there are four of us," Jay says.
sentences.zh: “现在我们有四个人了，”Jay 说。

sentences.en: "And we can meet after school, too," Alex says.
sentences.zh: “而且我们放学后也可以见面，”Alex 说。

sentences.en: "Saturday Club is our name, not our only day!"
sentences.zh: “周六俱乐部是我们的名字，不代表我们只能周六见面！”

sentences.en: Leo looks at the next page.
sentences.zh: Leo 看向下一页。

sentences.en: There is one more message: "Three books need a home."
sentences.zh: 还有一条留言：“三本书需要一个家。”

sentences.en: "Books have homes?" Jay asks.
sentences.zh: “书也有家吗？”Jay 问。

sentences.en: Alex points to a box by the door.
sentences.zh: Alex 指着门边的一个箱子。

sentences.en: "Are you ready for our first game?"
sentences.zh: “准备好玩我们的第一个游戏了吗？”

sentences.en: Alex opens the box by the library door.
sentences.zh: Alex 打开图书馆门边的箱子。

sentences.en: There are three books inside.
sentences.zh: 里面有三本书。

sentences.en: "Please help me put these books back," he says.
sentences.zh: “请帮我把这些书放回去，”他说。

sentences.en: "Each book has a picture on the front."
sentences.zh: “每本书的封面上都有一幅图画。”

sentences.en: "Can you choose the right place for each one?"
sentences.zh: “你们能为每一本选对地方吗？”

sentences.en: Mia chooses a book with a dog on the front.
sentences.zh: Mia 选了一本封面上有狗的书。

sentences.en: She carries it to a shelf near the window.
sentences.zh: 她把书拿到窗边的一个书架旁。

sentences.en: There are books about animals on this shelf.
sentences.zh: 这个书架上放着关于动物的书。

sentences.en: "This is the right place," she says.
sentences.zh: “就是这里，”她说。

sentences.en: She puts the book back.
sentences.zh: 她把书放了回去。

sentences.en: Jay chooses the book about food.
sentences.zh: Jay 选了那本关于食物的书。

sentences.en: He finds the right shelf, but it is full.
sentences.zh: 他找对了书架，但书架已经满了。

sentences.en: "Be careful," Mia says.
sentences.zh: “小心，”Mia 说。

sentences.en: "Don't put your book on top of those books."
sentences.zh: “别把你的书放在那些书上面。”

sentences.en: "Let's tidy up this shelf first."
sentences.zh: “我们先整理一下这个书架吧。”

sentences.en: Jay and Mia stand the books next to each other.
sentences.zh: Jay 和 Mia 把书一本挨着一本竖着摆好。

sentences.en: Now there is room for Jay's book.
sentences.zh: 现在有地方放 Jay 的书了。

sentences.en: "There!" Jay says. "A home for one more book."
sentences.zh: “好啦！”Jay 说，“又有一本书找到家了。”

sentences.en: Alex carries the empty box to the table.
sentences.zh: Alex 把空箱子拿到桌边。

sentences.en: "One book to go," he says.
sentences.zh: “还剩一本，”他说。

sentences.en: Leo has the last book.
sentences.zh: 最后一本书在 Leo 手里。

sentences.en: There is a picture of the moon on the front.
sentences.zh: 封面上有一幅月亮的图画。

sentences.en: He looks for books about the moon, but he cannot find them.
sentences.zh: 他寻找关于月亮的书，却没有找到。

sentences.en: "Can you help me?" he asks.
sentences.zh: “你们能帮帮我吗？”他问。

sentences.en: Mia points to a sign: "Science."
sentences.zh: Mia 指着一个写着“科学”的标牌。

sentences.en: Leo finds a place for the book on the science shelf.
sentences.zh: Leo 在科学书架上为这本书找到了位置。

sentences.en: "We can ask for help in this club," Alex says.
sentences.zh: “在这个俱乐部里，我们可以请别人帮忙，”Alex 说。

sentences.en: "Good," Jay says. "I have a question."
sentences.zh: “那太好了，”Jay 说，“我有个问题。”

sentences.en: He points under the table.
sentences.zh: 他指向桌子下面。

sentences.en: "Is that bag yours?"
sentences.zh: “那个书包是你的吗？”

questions.modelZh: 他们把三本书放回原处。

sentences.en: There is a red bag under the library table.
sentences.zh: 图书馆的桌子下面有一个红书包。

sentences.en: "It isn't mine," Alex says.
sentences.zh: “不是我的，”Alex 说。

sentences.en: Leo looks at the bag.
sentences.zh: Leo 看了看书包。

sentences.en: "There's a name on the front: Ben."
sentences.zh: “前面有个名字：Ben。”

sentences.en: "We need to find Ben," Mia says.
sentences.zh: “我们得找到 Ben，”Mia 说。

sentences.en: "I know two boys called Ben," Alex says.
sentences.zh: “我认识两个叫 Ben 的男孩，”Alex 说。

sentences.en: "Let's ask at the desk."
sentences.zh: “我们去服务台问问吧。”

sentences.en: They carry the bag to the woman at the desk.
sentences.zh: 他们把书包拿到服务台旁的女士那里。

sentences.en: She looks at a small pocket on the front.
sentences.zh: 她看了看书包前面的小口袋。

sentences.en: "There's a card in here," she says.
sentences.zh: “这里有张卡片，”她说。

sentences.en: The woman takes out the card and a key.
sentences.zh: 那位女士拿出卡片和一把钥匙。

sentences.en: There is an address on the card: 12 Park Road.
sentences.zh: 卡片上有个地址：Park Road 十二号。

sentences.en: "Please don't read it out to everyone," she says.
sentences.zh: “请不要把它念给大家听，”她说。

sentences.en: "I can find Ben's class. Thank you for your help."
sentences.zh: “我能查到 Ben 在哪个班。谢谢你们帮忙。”

sentences.en: The friends wait by the window.
sentences.zh: 朋友们在窗边等候。

sentences.en: A boy comes to the desk with a teacher.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩和一位老师来到服务台。

sentences.en: "Is this your bag, Ben?" the woman asks.
sentences.zh: “Ben，这是你的书包吗？”那位女士问。

sentences.en: "No. My bag is blue," he says.
sentences.zh: “不是。我的书包是蓝色的，”他说。

sentences.en: "The wrong Ben," Jay says.
sentences.zh: “找错 Ben 了，”Jay 轻声说。

sentences.en: "But thank you for coming," Mia says.
sentences.zh: “不过还是谢谢你过来，”Mia 说。

sentences.en: Another boy comes in with the teacher.
sentences.zh: 另一个男孩和那位老师一起走进来。

sentences.en: "My red bag!" he says.
sentences.zh: “我的红书包！”他说。

sentences.en: "What's inside?" the woman asks.
sentences.zh: “里面有什么？”那位女士问。

sentences.en: "It isn't empty. It's full of books," Ben says.
sentences.zh: “不是空的。里面装满了书，”Ben 说。

sentences.en: "And there's a key in the front pocket."
sentences.zh: “前面的口袋里还有一把钥匙。”

sentences.en: The woman checks the bag and gives it to Ben.
sentences.zh: 那位女士检查书包后，把它交给 Ben。

sentences.en: "Thank you!" he says to the friends.
sentences.zh: “谢谢你们！”他对朋友们说。

sentences.en: "I need these books for Monday."
sentences.zh: “星期一我得用这些书。”

sentences.en: "We put the books back, and now Ben has his bag back," Jay says.
sentences.zh: “我们把书放回原处，现在 Ben 也找回书包了，”Jay 说。

sentences.en: "Helping people makes me hungry!"
sentences.zh: “帮助别人真让我肚子饿！”

sentences.en: Leo, Mia, Jay and Alex sit at a table.
sentences.zh: Leo、Mia、Jay 和 Alex 围着一张桌子坐下。

sentences.en: "No games today?" Jay asks.
sentences.zh: “今天不玩游戏吗？”Jay 问。

sentences.en: "Lunch first," Mia says.
sentences.zh: “先吃午饭，”Mia 说。

sentences.en: Alex puts a small paper bag on the table.
sentences.zh: Alex 把一个小纸袋放在桌上。

sentences.en: Alex opens the bag. It is empty.
sentences.zh: Alex 打开纸袋。里面是空的。

sentences.en: "Oh, no! My sandwich is on the kitchen table at home."
sentences.zh: “糟了！我的三明治还放在家里的厨房桌子上。”

sentences.en: Jay looks at his lunch.
sentences.zh: Jay 看了看自己的午饭。

sentences.en: "I have two sandwiches. We can share," he says.
sentences.zh: “我有两个三明治。我们可以分着吃，”他说。

sentences.en: "Would you like one?"
sentences.zh: “你想要一个吗？”

sentences.en: "Are you sure?" Alex asks.
sentences.zh: “你确定吗？”Alex 问。

sentences.en: "Is there enough food for you?"
sentences.zh: “你自己够吃吗？”

sentences.en: "Yes. I have an apple and an egg, too," Jay says.
sentences.zh: “够。我还有一个苹果和一个鸡蛋，”Jay 说。

sentences.en: "I can share my fruit," Mia says.
sentences.zh: “我的水果也可以分给你，”Mia 说。

sentences.en: "Thanks. Now I have enough," Alex says.
sentences.zh: “谢谢。现在我够吃了，”Alex 说。

sentences.en: Leo goes to get a plate for Alex.
sentences.zh: Leo 去给 Alex 拿一个盘子。

sentences.en: He puts it on the table.
sentences.zh: 他把盘子放在桌上。

sentences.en: Mia puts some apple on the plate.
sentences.zh: Mia 在盘子里放了一些苹果。

sentences.en: "Would you like a fork?" Leo asks.
sentences.zh: “你要一把叉子吗？”Leo 问。

sentences.en: "Yes, please," Alex says.
sentences.zh: “好的，谢谢，”Alex 说。

sentences.en: Mia has a small bowl of soup with her lunch.
sentences.zh: Mia 的午饭还配着一小碗汤。

sentences.en: "What's in your soup?" Jay asks.
sentences.zh: “你的汤里有什么？”Jay 问。

sentences.en: "Tomato and egg," she says.
sentences.zh: “番茄和鸡蛋，”她说。

sentences.en: "Do you want to try some?"
sentences.zh: “你想尝一点吗？”

sentences.en: "No, thank you. I have enough food," Jay says.
sentences.zh: “不了，谢谢。我吃的已经够了，”Jay 说。

sentences.en: After lunch, Alex draws a picture in the blue book.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，Alex 在蓝书里画了一幅画。

sentences.en: It shows four friends at a table.
sentences.zh: 画里是四个围桌而坐的朋友。

sentences.en: Under it, he writes: "Thank you for sharing."
sentences.zh: 画下面，他写着：“谢谢你们和我分享。”

sentences.en: Mia looks at the picture.
sentences.zh: Mia 看着这幅画。

sentences.en: "We need a real photo of our club," she says.
sentences.zh: “我们需要一张俱乐部的真实合照，”她说。

sentences.en: Alex has a small camera. "Let's take a photo for our blue book," he says.
sentences.zh: Alex 带了一台小相机。“我们给蓝书拍张照片吧，”他说。

sentences.en: Jay stands behind a tall shelf and calls, "I'm ready!"
sentences.zh: Jay 站在一个高书架后面，喊道：“我准备好了！”

sentences.en: "We can't see you!" Mia says. "Stand in front of it, not behind it."
sentences.zh: “我们看不见你！”Mia 说，“站在它前面，别站在后面。”

sentences.en: Jay moves in front of the shelf. He is wearing Alex's blue hat.
sentences.zh: Jay 走到书架前面。他戴着 Alex 的蓝帽子。

sentences.en: "Now that's funny," Leo says. "The hat is bigger than your head!"
sentences.zh: “这下可真有趣，”Leo 说，“这顶帽子比你的头还大！”

sentences.en: "Who can take the photo?" Mia asks. "We need all four of us in it."
sentences.zh: “谁来拍照呢？”Mia 问，“我们四个都得在照片里。”

sentences.en: Jay gives the hat back. Alex puts the camera on a table. "It can wait ten seconds and then take one."
sentences.zh: Jay 把帽子还给 Alex。Alex 把相机放在桌上。“它可以等十秒钟再拍。”

sentences.en: Alex runs to the others, but his hat falls over his eyes.
sentences.zh: Alex 跑向其他人，可帽子滑下来挡住了眼睛。

sentences.en: The camera takes the photo. "Well, three faces in a photo are better than two," Jay says.
sentences.zh: 相机拍下了照片。“好吧，拍到三张脸总比两张好，”Jay 说。

sentences.en: They take another photo. This time, Alex holds the hat in his hand.
sentences.zh: 他们又拍了一张。这一回，Alex 把帽子拿在手里。

sentences.en: Inside the blue book, Mia finds an old photo of a little girl with the same hat.
sentences.zh: 在蓝书里，Mia 发现了一张旧照片，照片上的小女孩戴着同样的帽子。

sentences.en: On Friday, it starts to rain just as the friends leave school.
sentences.zh: 星期五，朋友们正要离开学校，天开始下雨。

sentences.en: Mia opens her umbrella. Jay looks in his bag, but his coat is at home.
sentences.zh: Mia 撑开雨伞。Jay 翻了翻书包，他的外套却在家里。

sentences.en: "Come under my umbrella," Mia says. "It can keep two people dry."
sentences.zh: “到我的伞下来吧，”Mia 说，“它能让两个人不被淋湿。”

sentences.en: "What about three?" Alex asks. He moves closer, and water runs on Jay's arm.
sentences.zh: “三个人行不行？”Alex 问。他靠近了一些，水却流到了 Jay 的胳膊上。

sentences.en: "I'm getting wet," Jay says. "Let's wait inside the school."
sentences.zh: “我被淋湿了，”Jay 说，“我们进学校里面等吧。”

sentences.en: They go back to the hall and tell the teacher at the door.
sentences.zh: 他们回到大厅，把情况告诉门口的老师。

sentences.en: "I can lend you a coat," Leo says. "I have another one in my classroom."
sentences.zh: “我可以借给你一件外套，”Leo 说，“我教室里还有一件。”

sentences.en: "Thank you," Jay says. "I'll give it back on Monday."
sentences.zh: “谢谢，”Jay 说，“我星期一还给你。”

sentences.en: While they wait, Mia shows Alex the old photo from the blue book.
sentences.zh: 等候时，Mia 把蓝书里的旧照片拿给 Alex 看。

sentences.en: "Who is this girl?" she asks. "And why is she wearing your hat?"
sentences.zh: “这个女孩是谁？”她问，“她为什么戴着你的帽子？”

sentences.en: "It isn't my hat," Alex says. "Someone at school lends it to our club."
sentences.zh: “那不是我的帽子，”Alex 说，“学校里有人把它借给我们俱乐部。”

sentences.en: Before Mia can ask another question, the rain stops. "Let's get home first," Leo says.
sentences.zh: Mia 还没来得及再问，下雨就停了。“我们先回家吧，”Leo 说。

sentences.en: Then Alex puts four cards on the library table. "One for each member," he says.
sentences.zh: 然后 Alex 在图书馆的桌上放了四张卡片。“每个成员一张，”他说。

sentences.en: "Do we need a test?" Jay asks. "I'm not ready for a test."

sentences.en: "No," Alex says. "A member is someone in our group. You are already members."

sentences.en: Mia draws a book on one side of her card and a ball on the other.
sentences.zh: Mia 在卡片的一面画了一本书，在另一面画了一个球。

sentences.en: "I like both," she says. "Can both pictures stay?"
sentences.zh: “两个我都喜欢，”她说，“两幅画都能留着吗？”

sentences.en: Jay writes, "Help people," on his card. Leo writes the same words.

sentences.en: "Good idea," Alex says. "But you can each choose your own picture."
sentences.zh: “好主意，”Alex 说，“不过你们每个人可以选自己想画的图。”

sentences.en: "Can we keep the cards?" Leo asks. "Or do they stay in the book?"
sentences.zh: “我们可以保留这些卡片吗？”Leo 问，“还是要放在书里？”

sentences.en: "Keep yours in your bag," Alex says. "Please don't write your home address on it."
sentences.zh: “把自己的卡片放在书包里吧，”Alex 说，“请不要在上面写家庭地址。”

sentences.en: There is a space for one more member's name at the bottom of the page.
sentences.zh: 那一页的下方还有一个位置，可以再写一个成员的名字。

sentences.en: "Who is that for?" Mia asks. Alex closes the book. "Someone we don't know yet."
sentences.zh: “那是留给谁的？”Mia 问。Alex 合上书。“一个我们还不认识的人。”

sentences.en: They arrive at school early enough to speak to the teacher before class.

sentences.en: "I don't understand this question," he says. "Can someone explain it?"
sentences.zh: “我不理解这道题，”他说，“有人能解释一下吗？”

sentences.en: Leo begins to read out his answer. "Wait," Mia says. "Let's look at Jay's question first."

sentences.en: It asks how two people go to school, but Jay writes about only one person.

sentences.en: "Tell us about both people," Alex says. "You can try again."
sentences.zh: “把两个人的情况都告诉我们，”Alex 说，“你可以再试一次。”

sentences.en: Jay talks about himself and his brother. Then he writes a new sentence in his own words.
sentences.zh: Jay 说了说自己和哥哥的情况，然后用自己的话重新写了一个句子。

sentences.en: "Let's check it for mistakes," Mia says. "Read the sentence to us."
sentences.zh: “我们检查有没有错误，”Mia 说，“把句子读给我们听吧。”

sentences.en: Jay reads his sentence and stops at the word "walk". "I need an s here."
sentences.zh: Jay 读自己的句子，读到 walk 时停下来。“这里需要加个 s。”

sentences.en: "My brother walks to school," Jay says, and adds the letter s.
sentences.zh: “My brother walks to school，”Jay 说着，加上了字母 s。

sentences.en: "Now I understand," he says. "My brother means he. We say, 'He walks.'"
sentences.zh: “现在我明白了，”他说，“my brother 可以用 he 代替。我们说 He walks。”

sentences.en: Jay closes his book. "Thank you for explaining, not just giving me an answer."
sentences.zh: Jay 合上书。“谢谢你们解释给我听，而不是直接给我答案。”

sentences.en: Then Alex opens the blue book to a picture of a ball. "Who wants to play tomorrow?"
sentences.zh: 然后 Alex 翻开蓝书，露出一幅球的图画。“明天谁想一起玩？”

sentences.en: "The first game had an end," Alex says. "But the club doesn't need one yet."

sentences.en: Mia puts a small picture of the blue hat beside the message, just like on their poster.
sentences.zh: Mia 在留言旁边画了一顶小蓝帽，就像他们海报上的那样。

sentences.en: The student at the door finally comes in. "Do I have to be good at games?" she asks.
sentences.zh: 门口的同学终于走了进来。“我一定得很会玩游戏吗？”她问。

sentences.en: "No," Jay says. "Just be ready to try. And please tell us your name."
sentences.zh: “不用，”Jay 说，“愿意尝试就好。还有，告诉我们你的名字吧。”

sentences.en: In the library, the blue book is nearly full. The friends look through it with Ms. Reed.
sentences.zh: 在图书馆，蓝书快写满了。朋友们和 Reed 老师一起从头翻看。

sentences.en: "Are you sure that's me?" Jay asks, pointing to the first club photo.
sentences.zh: “你们确定那是我吗？”Jay 指着第一张俱乐部合照问。

sentences.en: They remember the lost bag, the shared lunch and the wrong turn upstairs.
sentences.zh: 他们想起了捡到的书包、一起分享的午饭，以及那次上错楼的经历。

sentences.en: Sam looks at his train card. "I hope the next book has room for more people."
sentences.zh: Sam 看看自己的火车卡片。“希望下一本书能装下更多人。”

sentences.en: Ms. Reed asks, "What is your wish for the future of this club?"
sentences.zh: Reed 老师问：“关于俱乐部的未来，你们有什么愿望？”

sentences.en: "More music," says Leo. "More books," says Mia. "More lunches," says Jay.
sentences.zh: “更多音乐，”Leo 说。“更多书，”Mia 说。“更多午饭，”Jay 说。

sentences.en: Alex gets out a new book. "I hope we continue to help people," he says.
sentences.zh: Alex 拿出一本新书。“我希望我们继续帮助别人，”他说。

sentences.en: "And ask for help when we need it," Sam adds. Ms. Reed agrees.
sentences.zh: “需要时也请别人帮助我们，”Sam 补充道。Reed 老师表示赞同。

sentences.en: Mia writes "Book Two" on the new cover. "This isn't goodbye, then?" Jay asks.
sentences.zh: Mia 在新封面上写下“第二本”。“这么说，不是要告别啦？”Jay 问。

sentences.en: "No," she says. "It's 'see you soon'. We can decide our next story together."
sentences.zh: “不是，”她说，“是‘很快再见’。下一个故事，我们一起决定。”

sentences.en: On the last page of the old book, they write: "Look at the board. There is room for you."
sentences.zh: 在旧书最后一页，他们写道：“看看布告栏。这里有你的位置。”

sentences.en: Then they close it and go to meet their new friend at the door.
sentences.zh: 然后他们合上书，去门口迎接新朋友。
